pr_title: [feature] Support dspark speculative method and synchronize reorder batch threshold calculation with vLLM
source_quote: For qwen-dspark, the q-len during draft model inference is **num_speculative_tokens**, not **`1 + num_speculative_tokens`**. Should this be changed to only num_speculative_tokens? (This setting is different from that of dflash.)

antipattern.code:
class AscendGDNAttentionMetadataBuilder:
    """Metadata builder for GDN attention."""

    def __init__(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig, ...):
        self.vllm_config = vllm_config
        self.reorder_batch_threshold = 1
        # ... 其他初始化 ...
        self._init_reorder_batch_threshold()

    def _init_reorder_batch_threshold(self):
        """Initialize batch reorder threshold for speculative decoding."""
        if self.reorder_batch_threshold != 1:  # type: ignore
            return
        speculative_config = self.vllm_config.speculative_config
        if (
            speculative_config is not None
            and speculative_config.num_speculative_tokens is not None
            and hasattr(speculative_config, "method")
            and speculative_config.method in ("dflash", "dspark")  # ← 错：dflash 和 dspark 混写一个分支
        ):
            # dflash 的 q-len = 1+N（含 base token），dspark 的 q-len = N（不含 base token）
            # 统一写 1+N 对 dspark 来说多留了 1 个 token slot = 浪费吞吐 + 调度错位
            self.reorder_batch_threshold = 1 + speculative_config.num_speculative_tokens
            #                                                          ↑ 错：dspark 只应是 N

pattern.code:
class AscendGDNAttentionMetadataBuilder:
    """Metadata builder for GDN attention."""

    def __init__(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig, ...):
        self.vllm_config = vllm_config
        self.reorder_batch_threshold = 1
        # ... 其他初始化 ...
        self._init_reorder_batch_threshold()

    def _init_reorder_batch_threshold(self):
        """Initialize batch reorder threshold for speculative decoding."""
        if self.reorder_batch_threshold != 1:  # type: ignore
            return
        speculative_config = self.vllm_config.speculative_config
        if speculative_config is None:
            return
        method = getattr(speculative_config, "method", None)
        num_spec = getattr(speculative_config, "num_speculative_tokens", None)
        if num_spec is not None:
            # dflash counts the base token in addition to the N speculative
            # tokens; dspark's threshold is just N by design.
            if method == "dflash":
                self.reorder_batch_threshold = 1 + num_spec    # ✅ dflash: q-len = 1+N
            elif method == "dspark":
                self.reorder_batch_threshold = num_spec        # ✅ dspark: q-len = N
        # 净统计：gdn_attn_builder.py +9/-7
        # 配套健壮性提升：speculative_config.method / num_speculative_tokens
        # 改用 getattr(..., None) 模式获取，避免缺字段时抛 AttributeError
